notes.content: This agreement displays all lower-division courses required in the major: CSU Northridge courses on the left, approved (articulated) transfer courses to the right. General education (Cal-GETC or CSU Northridge GE) and upper-division courses are also required to complete the bachelor's degree. This agreement displays all lower-division courses required in the major: CSU Northridge courses on the left, approved (articulated) transfer courses to the right. General education (Cal-GETC or CSU Northridge GE) and upper-division courses are also required to complete the bachelor's degree.


Completion of all coursework listed in this agreement is not mandatory prior to admission. For CSU Northridge Undergraduate Admission Requirements, refer to Upper Division Transfer.
